info.name: Question & Answer API
info.description: Manual collection for the DevAnswers Question and Answer API. Set token to a JWT returned by POST /api/auth/login before running protected requests. Set questionId and answerId to existing MongoDB ObjectIds, or run the create requests to capture them automatically. Owner/admin endpoints require the authenticated user to own the resource or have isAdmin=true. For error checks, remove the inherited Authorization header for a missing-token test, replace token with an invalid JWT for an invalid-token test, use another user's token for a 403 authorization test, use a malformed ObjectId for an invalid-ID test, and omit required JSON fields for validation tests.

request.description: Public endpoint. Returns questions populated with author and tags, plus answerCount. Expected success status: 200. If no questions exist, the implementation returns 404.
Public endpoint. Returns the question with populated author/tags and all answers. Expected success status: 200. Test a missing or malformed questionId for the resource error behavior.
Requires a valid token. tags must be a comma-separated string, not an array. Missing title or description returns 400; no/invalid token returns 401. Expected success status: 200.

request.description: Requires a valid token and an existing questionId. Only the question owner or an admin may update it; another authenticated user should receive 403. Missing fields may be omitted for a partial update. Expected success status: 200. Test missing/invalid token, invalid ID, nonexistent ID, and missing fields.

Requires a valid token and an existing questionId. Only the owner or an admin may delete it; another authenticated user should receive 403. Expected success status: 200. Test missing/invalid token, invalid ID, and nonexistent ID.
Requires a valid token and an existing questionId. Expected success status: 200. Repeat the request, switch to Downvote Question, and test an invalid/nonexistent ID to verify handleVote behavior.
Requires a valid token and an existing questionId. Expected success status: 200. Test repeating the vote, switching from Upvote Question, missing/invalid token, and an invalid/nonexistent ID.
Public endpoint. Returns all answers for questionId. Expected success status: 200. If no answers exist, the implementation returns 404. Test a malformed or nonexistent questionId.
Requires a valid token and an existing questionId. answerText is required; missing it returns 400. No/invalid token returns 401. Expected success status: 201.
